For years, Dragon Ball’s home releases have suffered from wrong colours, bad framing, heavy noise reduction, and compromised audio - to the point that we’ve even colour-corrected footage in our own videos just to show how broken they are. In this video, we take a look at Seed of Might, a fan preservation project restoring Dragon Ball, Dragon Ball Z, Dragon Ball GT, the movies, and Dragon Ball Kai back toward their original intent, and why this might finally be the best way to watch Dragon Ball Z in 2026.
